register.title: Create account
register.openTelegram: To get the code for {{phone}}, open our Telegram bot and share your phone number.
register.newCodeSent: A new code is on its way.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.summary: Permanently close your Mazad account. Open orders, auctions, returns and any wallet balance must be finished first.

consequences.permanent: Your account is closed permanently and can't be restored.
consequences.removed: Your name, phone number, addresses, saved items, followed sellers, notifications, Telegram link and push notification registrations are removed.
consequences.kept: Your orders, bids, wins, returns, refunds and payment records are kept, because the other party and our accounting need them, but they no longer show your name.
consequences.signedOut: You're signed out on all your devices.
consequences.phone: The same phone number can't be used to create a new account for 30 days.

deleteAccount.passwordHint: Enter your password. If you signed up with a phone code and have no password, leave it empty.
deleteAccount.confirmLabel: I understand this can't be undone.
deleteAccount.reauthAction: Sign out and sign in again

blocked.title: Your account can't be deleted yet. First finish:
blocked.hint: Once these are done, come back and delete your account.

reasons.SELLER_AUCTIONS_ACTIVE: Auctions you're selling that are pending approval, scheduled, live, or ended and still waiting on the winner.
reasons.SELLER_ORDERS_OPEN: Orders you sold that haven't been delivered or cancelled yet.
reasons.SELLER_RETURN_WINDOW_OPEN: Orders you sold that were delivered recently and are still within the return period.
reasons.BUYER_ORDERS_OPEN: Your purchases that haven't been delivered or cancelled yet.
reasons.WINS_PENDING: Auctions you won that are waiting for your confirmation.
reasons.RETURNS_OPEN: Return requests in progress, as a buyer or a seller.
reasons.LEADING_BIDS: Live auctions where you hold the highest bid.
reasons.WALLET_NOT_EMPTY: A balance or a held amount in your wallet.
reasons.unknown: Another open item on your account.

errors.PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter your password to delete your account.
errors.REAUTH_REQUIRED: For your security, an account without a password needs a recent sign-in. Set a password with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page, then delete your account using it.
errors.ACCOUNT_DELETION_NOT_ALLOWED: This account can't be deleted here.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your Mazad account
accountDeletion.intro: You can permanently delete your Mazad account yourself, in the Mazad app or on this website. This page explains how, and what happens to your data.

steps.signIn: Sign in to your Mazad account, in the app or on the website.
steps.delete: At the bottom of the Account screen, choose Delete account and confirm. You'll be asked for your password if your account has one.

accountDeletion.passwordless: If your account has no password (for example, it was created with a phone code), first set one with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page, then delete your account using it.
accountDeletion.beforeIntro: An account can't be deleted while it still has open business with other people. Finish these first; the delete screen lists anything that is still open:

field.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
field.passwordMax: Password must be at most 128 characters.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: Enter your phone number and we'll send you a verification code.
reset.done: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
